methodology.note: Each anchor episode contributes at most one combined sample at the first bar where all added conditions are simultaneously known.
methodology.causality: Prefix evidence and full evidence restricted to the same knownThrough checkpoint must produce identical condition episodes.
methodology.purpose: Mechanism and causality validation only; these results are not model rankings or return forecasts.

regressionNotes: Initial audit exposed future Evidence being clamped to knownThrough; fixed by filtering on detectedAt/index <= knownThrough.
Initial overlap sampling allowed multiple transient-event episodes inside one anchor state; replaced with anchor-centric sampling so combo N cannot exceed baseline anchor episodes.
